O.outcome_detail: Observed involvement, participation, and interest during lessons

cells.quote: There is a general increase in the level of involvement and participation of the second language learners on the JPA in the experimental group probably because of the activities students were engaged in. Students and teachers were actively involved in the discussion of the passages before they were read. In the JPA lessons that were observed, second language learners generally showed keen interest in the discussion.
cells.note: This is the authors' observational interpretation, not a tested result; no measure or statistic is reported.
